title: full four-sleeve shadow readiness + dashboard cutover
claim: Track1-only full four-sleeve shadow is ready to be started by operator.
claim_limits: NOT broker-flat / orphan-STP clean (account-level, unmeasured against IBKR)
NOT safe to delete legacy before the measured shadow period passes
slot runtimes against a live Gateway remain UNMEASURED - the first shadow session IS the measurement, judged by the acceptance gate

inventory.argv_probe: all 81 track1 children fired with the runner mocked: route=track1_candidate on every one; 70 strategy slots all ibkr, no --allow-orders/--port/--window; 11 safety jobs all on live_positions.track1.json

acceptance_gate.committed: before any shadow day exists, so thresholds cannot drift toward the first day's results

checks.coverage: per sleeve, window COMPLETE with close record: 1/24/23/22 decided
checks.slot_gaps: every registered slot id has a ledger row (a count hides one silent + one doubled; the ids do not)
checks.stalls: no single slot at or over 300s
checks.no_orders: no order mark in any record, B1 open, no confirmation file
checks.freshness_proofs: every explanation row carries a freshness proof
checks.checkpoint: exists, route=track1_candidate, cut on the judged day
checks.checkpoint_identity: NOT_CHECKED_HERE by name - params-hash acceptance needs frames (route_checkpoint.usable); a green day cannot be read as having verified it
checks.no_telemetry: FAILS the day - a day nobody measured cannot be accepted as in budget

acceptance_gate.period: evaluate_period accepts only when every day is accepted

dashboard_cutover.before: the dashboard had NO Track 1 reader; /api/v1/runner-positions serves live_positions.json with no route label
dashboard_cutover.new_reader: monitor/backend/track1_runtime_reader.py - reads live_positions.track1.json, replay_checkpoint.track1.json, track1_runtime/window_coverage, track1_runtime/slot_timing, track1_runtime/shadow explanations, the gate registry and the safety table. Read-only (AST-verified: no open/write/mkdir)
dashboard_cutover.legacy_labelled: /api/v1/runner-positions payload now carries route=legacy and a note pointing at the Track 1 endpoint
dashboard_cutover.never_reads_legacy_book: asserted by AST scan of the reader's source; mutation P1 re-arms it and the scan reds
dashboard_cutover.absence_is_data: a missing Track 1 book reads as the EXPECTED shadow state, not an error

operator.no_order_path: B1 open, no --allow-orders anywhere, no confirmation file, order env stripped by the launcher; enabling orders is NOT part of 5P
operator.legacy_drain: legacy safety keeps watching live_positions.json until that book drains

legacy_removable: with global_index.run_live_day unimportable (meta-path block): the 95-job schedule builds, the dashboard reader renders a green day, and the acceptance gate accepts it
format_drift_guard: one row written through the REAL window_ledger and slot_telemetry APIs parses in the gate's readers

mutations.mutation: P1 the Track 1 reader opens live_positions.json
P2 the gate stops judging one sleeve's coverage
P3 the gate reads legacy's replay_checkpoint.json
P4 Track 1 safety points at legacy's book
P5 a legacy strategy job survives track1-only
P6 the safety job table loses a job (count drift)
P7 --allow-orders on a Track 1 strategy slot
P8 the gate's coverage path points into scratch

harness_note: P3's first form moved fixture and judge together (they share the constant) and went undetected 0/0/0; repointed at the cross-module path-equality guard, which the mutation does not move. 8/8 after

tests.mutations: 8/8 detected, both production files restored byte-for-byte
tests.full_sweep: 545 passed, 1 skipped; the one failure was a pre-existing stale start_scheduler stub in monitor/test_dashboard_backend.py (signature grew in 5K/5M-D) - widened, then 187 passed
